messages:
alex: kicking off a small canary for model catalog enable -> orion-quant-v2 at 5% traffic (EU + us-west). change window 03:30-04:30 UTC. observability escrow ON. tagging @maria @jamal for fallback + pin coordination. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled (id: canary-1719998888-orion-qv2). targets: 5% EU, 5% us-west. preflight checks passed. link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/canary/1719998888

jamal: quick q — what's the fallback ordering for this canary? do we fall back to orion-quant-v1 first or jump to titan-lite?

maria: catalog fallback set to ["orion-quant-v1", "titan-lite", "default-small"] for this rollout. enterprise pins untouched unless ops asks.

alex: correct — enterprise stays pinned to v1 for 24h post-stable. rollback triggers (auto): p95 latency > 250ms sustained for 5m OR token-error-rate > 0.5% for 3m. auto-rollback will reapply previous priority ladder. manual rollback also allowed.

ops-oncall: I'll enable higher-res pre-aggregates on /telemetry/canary (10s buckets) and add pager rule for p95 and token errors. PMs get an informational alert only.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started, initial sampling routing 20 requests across regions. watchlist: latency_p95, model_rerate, llm_token_errors. health checks OK.

tara: :thumbsup: running a warm-cache prefill for top prefixes via `/scripts/prefill_prefixes --model orion-quant-v2 --top 200` now. should reduce cold-start noise in first 10 minutes.

jamal: please ensure catalog flag has fallback_priority explicitly ordered to prefer v1 on errors. want to avoid hitting titan-lite unless v1 also fails.

alex: done. catalog flag updated and change window locked. also adding a smoke-eval gate: if eval_score drops > 3 pts compared to baseline -> pause and notify @eng-sre + @product.

maria: drafting release notes: "orion-quant-v2: 5% canary in EU + US-west. configured fallbacks, rollback SLOs, and opt-out guidance for pinned customers." will post in #release-notes once finalized.

jamal: ops: please produce a list of dedicated customers who have explicit model pins so we can reach out if needed. we may offer opt-out for first 24h.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary t+5m: steady-state observed, 0 token errors, p95 latency = 142ms (EU), 138ms (us-west). continuing ramp plan: hold 30m then +5% per 30m.

alex: awesome. escalation path: if anything looks off, call a rollback with `POST /internal/rollbacks` or ping #eng-releases-incident. otherwise we'll proceed with gradual increments every 30m. thanks everyone.
